dmp.description: This DMP is developed in the framework of the project "Baltic German and Baltic German Literature" (lzp-2025/1-0170). The aim of the project is to complete the history of the Baltic Germans both in the Baltic and German cultural context. While the linguistic part connects conceptual novelty with a modern approach to the language history, highlighting regionality, contact linguistics, as well as aspects of applied linguistics, the literary research (primarily: female autobiography) contributes to the international discourse of literary studies.
